critical_concerns.description: Primary gate failure is being overridden: selected C4 rank_ic=0.0385 is below the declared 0.04 minimum, and the script falls back after no candidate satisfies all gates while challenge_flags remains empty.

PIT-clean is overstated: Date <= sig_date is insufficient for a price-based D57 signal when the backtest enters at the same sig_date close. Without t-1 factor snapshots or next-session execution, same-day circularity remains possible.
Monotonicity is a hard alpha-quality failure: monotonicity=0.25 vs required 0.80, yet the note reframes it as mid-quintile noise and pushes validation to downstream sleeves.
RF-A6 remains open: reported 5-spec evidence is not the required CAPM/Carhart-3/Carhart-4/FF5/FF6 regression family, and only 2/5 reported stress t_NW specs pass.
AX-005/AX-007 exception is still a promise, not evidence. The delivered alpha is a single downside-vol proxy; risk_package, optimization_package, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are absent.
Lockbox separation is missing. The package reports combined 2004-2026 diagnostics and selection without Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined three-way reporting.
Sector-neutral robustness is untested despite RF-A4; the package explicitly says sector-neutral post-test was not run.

Artifact integrity is incomplete: requested dir A is absent, weights/covariance artifacts are absent, and stale orthogonality_ym_aligned.csv conflicts with alpha_validation/package orthogonality values.
